title: Topic 11
japanese_text: 2021年、新型コロナウイルス流行による緊急事態<u>宣言</u>が出される中、オリンピック中止を求めるデモ<u>行進</u>の<u>決行</u>が<u>告知され</u>た。政府は<u>厳密な</u>感染対策をとって開催すると言っていたが、それで安全だという根拠には<u>乏しかった</u>。
english_translation: In 2021, amid the state of emergency declared due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the decisive action of a demonstration march calling for cancellation of the Olympics was announced. The government said it would hold the games under strict infection control measures, but there was scant evidence that this would be safe enough.
